newsitem.title: USA: Boston Communications sees Q4 loss.
newsitem.headline: Boston Communications sees Q4 loss.

text.p: Boston Communications Group Inc said Friday it expects a net loss for the fourth quarter of $0.01 to $0.02 per share, compared with a year-earlier profit of $0.13.
The company said it expects revenues for the fourth quarter of $12-$12.5 million, compared to $9.7 million a year ago.
Revenues for 1996 will be substantially higher than 1995 and the company will be profitable for the full year, Boston Communications said.

Boston Communications also said it expects revenue and net income for the first half of 1997 to grow at a slower pace than previously anticipated. But for 1997 as a whole, the company said it expects solid increases in revenues compared with 1996.
It said higher-than-expected investments in infrastructure, sales and marketing affected revenues for the fourth quarter.

It also cited lower-than-anticipated revenues from its ROAMERplus calling service, delays in carrier deployment of its prepaid calling services, and fewer-than-expected carrier support special projects.
